in_sanskrit.name: देवग्रहन्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is descended from the gods.

in_marathi.name: Devgrahanth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devgrahanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devgrahanth is a Sanskrit name composed of two roots: Deva (god) and Grahanth (messenger). This name signifies a divine messenger of God or a person who carries God's message.
